THEOREM · qeva:1:one-plus-one@2

One plus one equals two

In the declared Peano rewrite kernel, the closed term adding one to one normalizes to two.

machine-checkedarithmetic · proof
Trace this conceptSearch connections

PLAIN

The idea

The kernel expands addition once, then removes addition by zero, leaving exactly the term used to define two.

EXACT

The compact statement

With 1:=S(0), 2:=S(S(0)), add(a,0)→a, and add(a,S(b))→S(add(a,b)), the closed term add(1,1) normalizes by two certified rewrites to 2.

Example

add(S(0),S(0)) → S(add(S(0),0)) → S(S(0)).

Boundary / caveat

This establishes syntactic normalization in the declared rewrite kernel. It does not by itself prove soundness of a broader arithmetic theory.

Assumptions

  • The two recursive addition equations are used as oriented rewrite rules. · Addition @1
  • The symbols 0 and S belong to the declared natural-number presentation. · Natural number @2
